draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) suggest that salience pre-filtering may help reduce unsupported entities in summaries.
rationale: P1 describes the filtering method but says nothing about unsupported entities or hallucination reduction. The reduction evidence (T1.r2 vs T1.r1) is the package's own re-implementation, not Varga & Sandoval's claim. The attribution to the cited work is unsupported.
